summary: Keep preview gateway bearer credentials out of the development server environment by reading protected credential files in-process.

replay.detail: No replay or rebuild of persisted state.

schema.detail: No database or wire schema changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Preview launchers and the Vite gateway now accept WF_ST_CREDENTIAL_FILE only. WF_ST_AUTHORIZATION is no longer read. The production host retains its existing file-reference configuration.

downtime.detail: No service downtime is required by this change.

manual.detail: Configure preview callers with WF_ST_CREDENTIAL_FILE referencing a credential file owned by the development server user and unreadable by others. Remove the legacy WF_ST_AUTHORIZATION setting.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or recovery steps.
